derivation.B: Only steps 4/5 involve HBrO2: r5 = r4 with held-constant Br- cancelling, [HBrO2]B = k5[BrO3-][H+]/k4 = (2.1)(0.06)(0.8)/(2.0e9) = 5.04e-11 M.
